title.narrative: Strengthened institutional capacity of workers' organizations

description.narrative:
Workers’ organizations in Jordan play an important role in social dialogue and in shaping policies related to labour governance, social protection, working conditions and the green transition. The ILO will support the General Federation of Jordanian Trade Unions (GFJTU) and relevant sectoral unions to strengthen their institutional and technical capacity to develop and advocate evidence-based workers’ positions in national policy and social dialogue processes.
Building on GFJTU’s strategic vision and the establishment of its Just Transition and Green Jobs Unit, support will focus on strengthening workers’ engagement in discussions on climate action, just transition and green jobs, including the development of workers’ inputs to Jordan’s NDC 3.0 revision process. The intervention will also support workers’ organizations to contribute to policy dialogue on occupational safety and health, working conditions and responsible business conduct in priority sectors, promoting inclusive and sustainable labour market outcomes.
